contexts.text: Ye will make my grey hair to go down () = that thus there will be the last of the Church. Grey hair, when the Church is treated of, = the last of it. Illustrated.
Ye shall make my grey hair to go down in evil to the grave () = that spiritual good will perish, and thus the Internal of the Church... Grey hair = the last of the Church.
The birth, and afterwards the education and perfection, are signified by to be carried from the womb, even to old age I am the same, and even to grey hair will I carry you ().
